0x01.description: Donates host DRAM physical pages as Datacubes to ExclaveOS PMM server.
0x01.arguments: struct exclaves_donate_page_args { uint64_t paddr; uint64_t size; uint32_t mem_type; uint32_t flags; }
0x01.semantics: Unmaps physical address range from Darwin Stage-1 translation tables, notifies SPTM, and triggers pmm-server retyping.

0x02.description: Reclaims released Datacubes after ExclaveOS zero-fill scrubbing.
0x02.arguments: struct exclaves_reclaim_page_args { uint64_t paddr; uint64_t size; }
0x02.semantics: Verifies that pmm-server has executed xnu_frame_unreserve and remaps page into host Darwin physical memory pool.

0x03.description: Queries ExclaveOS subsystem health, active Conclave count, and memory carveout statistics.
0x03.arguments: struct exclaves_status_args { struct exclaves_allocation_statistics *stats; size_t buffer_len; }

0x04.description: Updates sensor arbitration state machine (e.g. camera, microphone active status).
0x04.arguments: struct exclaves_sensor_state_args { uint32_t sensor_type; uint32_t state; uint64_t timestamp; }
0x04.semantics: Invokes _exclaves_indicator_system_state_change to arbitrate Sensor Indicator Light (SIL) status.

_exclaves_call_trap.name: _exclaves_call_trap
_exclaves_call_trap.prototype: int _exclaves_call_trap(uint64_t endpoint_token, const void *in_msg, size_t in_size, void *out_msg, size_t *out_size)
_exclaves_call_trap.semantics: Copies userland Tightbeam message payload into per-thread IPC buffer (ipcb_paddr), enters exclaves_run in exclaves_xnuproxy.c, transitions through RingGate via sk_enter, and blocks until Conclave replies.

_exclaves_boot_trap.name: _exclaves_boot_trap
_exclaves_boot_trap.semantics: Executed during Darwin kernel initialization (exclaves_boot.c). Verifies BUND archive signature, measures firmware segments, and passes exclaves_bootinfo to Apple Silicon SPTM.

stages.name: EXCLAVES_BOOT_PROBE
stages.description: Detects Apple Silicon Exclave hardware capabilities

stages.name: EXCLAVES_BOOT_LOAD
stages.description: Loads ExclaveCore BUND into SPM carveout

stages.name: EXCLAVES_BOOT_INIT
stages.description: Executes exclaves_aoe_boot and activates cL4 scheduler hook

notification_servers.role: General asynchronous event notification server from ExclaveOS to Darwin kernel
Direct event distribution channel routing notifications to Darwin userland daemons (sharingd, apsd, backboardd)

ipc_buffer_mapping.description: Each XNU thread participating in exclave calls allocates a dedicated 512-byte IPC buffer mapped shared read-write between XNU and ExclaveOS.

fields.name: ipcb_paddr
fields.description: Physical address of thread IPC buffer

fields.name: saved_state
fields.description: Pointer to saved ARM64 register frame

spm_domain_transitions.hardware_monitor: Apple Silicon Secure Page Table Monitor (SPTM / SPM)
cache_invariants: Data cache clean to Point of Coherence (dc cvac) executed on IPC buffer prior to sk_enter.
Instruction cache invalidate (ic ivau) executed upon retyped executable pages.
Memory barrier (dmb ish / isb) serialized across domain crossings.

domain_fault_isolation.policy: Isolated Exclave crashes do not panic the Darwin host kernel.
domain_fault_isolation.translation_fault_routing: SPTM redirects translation faults in Conclave VAS to cL4 vas_faulthandler_vtable.
domain_fault_isolation.panic_fallback: Unrecoverable microkernel exceptions enter EXCLAVES_PANIC_WAIT_THREAD, freezing the Conclave while allowing Darwin to collect diagnostic stackshots.
